sources.facts: Regular Basic: 1vCPU/2GiB/50GiB/2000GiB transfer $12; 2vCPU/2GiB/60GiB/3000GiB $18; 2vCPU/4GiB/80GiB/4000GiB $24 monthly. Shared CPU, per-second billing monthly caps, minimum 60 seconds or $.01.
Ingress free; outbound over included accrued pool $.01/GiB. Pool depends on uptime.
Additional network block storage $.10/GiB/month; billed even unattached. Not selected for SQLite.
Account/jurisdiction determines applicable taxes. Bangladesh absence from extracted list is not proof of no tax.
EU CX23 new rate June15 2026 $6.49/month excluding IPv4 and VAT.
CX23 2vCPU/4GB/40GB NVMe, 20TB EU transfer, currently unavailable; low-medium CPU usage; billed until deleted. No available cheap-host assumption.
Shared Linode4GB 2CPU80GB4TB $24/month $.036/hour. Core egress overage $.005/GB. Extra block storage $ .10/GB-month (must verify specific disk option before adoption). No account tax determination.
Free web sleeps after 15min idle; ephemeral filesystem, no persistent disk. Unsuitable for selected invited-Alpha topology; owner/mock development only.
Paygo $6.95/TB/30days, first10GB advertised free; no minimum file size/storage duration; egress3x average stored bytes included then $.01/GB; API A/B/C free; D $.004/10000 after2500/day.

Upload/version-delete A, reads B, version-list C are free paygo. D event notifications excluded from candidate. Page also shows stale/conflicting $.005/GB storage note; model uses higher main pricing $.00695/GB pending account quote.
Hiding a file does not delete retained versions. Enumerate and delete every affected version; no immutable lock adopted.

Standard $.015/GB-month, A $4.50/million, B $.36/million, usage rounds up to billing units. Advertised free10GB/1M A/10M B. Egress free; DeleteObject free; Standard no minimum duration. No IA adopted.
Direct object deletion/listing strongly consistent; cached custom domain can retain deleted content. Candidate private backup uses direct API, not cached/public media.
Official card FAQ points to applicable current card charge schedule for FX markup/fees. Not evidence of owner bank/card or exact rate; no tax/FX policy selected.
